title: Middle convolution for affine hyperplane arrangements and Aomoto realizability
summary: We construct middle convolution for local systems on complements of affine hyperplane arrangements. Our aim is to study Aomoto realizability: whether a local system can be realized by a flat logarithmic connection on a trivial bundle with constant residue matrices. For a chosen direction, we minimally enlarge the arrangement so that projection becomes a bundle of punctured affine lines. On the associated relative stratification, we extend Katz's middle convolution to constructible perverse sheaves and prove compatibility with its action on the fibers.
